title: The Book of Held Resolve
summary: A book on holding a resolve past the point where the body asks to stop and spending it in a guard and a blow.

title: Course in Willed Force
summary: A course on sending force out of the body by will alone and shaping it into a push that needs no touch.

title: Treatise on Command and Compulsion
summary: A treatise on the command that is obeyed against the listener's wish and the cost of speaking it.

title: Manual of the Unyielding Mind
summary: A manual on a mind that gives way to no pressure and a body that borrows that firmness.

title: The Tenfold Intent Course
summary: A long course that splits one intent into ten separate lines and sends each to a different task of the fight.

title: Treatise on Reading Intent
summary: A treatise on feeling what an opponent means to do a breath before they do it and on cleansing the mind of fear.

title: Primer of Rallying Will
summary: A primer on lending will to others so that a small band can hold when each alone would break.
